ranked.headline: Deep learning models decompose and denoise single-cell and spatial transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Generative and graph-based models now target multimodal, spatial, and cross-platform transcriptomic data, alongside a 21-method deconvolution benchmark.

ranked.headline: Generative models steer biomolecular sequences toward explicit design objectives
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair diffusion, reinforcement fine-tuning, and agentic tool search with explicit control over activity, binding, and diversity.

ranked.headline: Live imaging and RNA kinetics infer single-cell fate and state dynamics
ranked.summary: Time-resolved measurements from live imaging, splicing kinetics and fluorescence traces are now feeding dynamical models of single-cell behavior.

ranked.headline: Evaluation layers and bias correction reshape omics analysis pipeline performance
ranked.summary: Benchmark design and sample-level biases determine reported performance across RNA-seq, scRNA-seq, miRNA-seq and multi-omics workflows.

ranked.headline: Simulators fail to capture full Nanopore error profiles in microbial genome benchmarking
ranked.summary: Pipelines for pathogen and bacterial genomes now face direct validation against real Nanopore and short-read data.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of genome and epigenome features from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Recent items validate computational inference tools against reference or orthogonal data across single-cell, bulk, and transcriptomic sequencing.

ranked.headline: Automated analysis pipelines for high-dimensional single-cell and cellular imaging data
ranked.summary: Automated preprocessing, benchmarking, and segmentation tools are emerging for high-dimensional single-cell and imaging datasets.

ranked.headline: Structuring biomedical literature into computable objects under human oversight
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply LLM agents and causal-graph methods to extract executable and computable knowledge from published biomedical literature.

ranked.headline: Software and machine learning tools refine variant annotation and pathogenicity scoring
ranked.summary: Faster reimplementations and HGVS-aware predictors are reshaping how clinical and somatic variants are annotated and interpreted.

ranked.headline: Deep learning links noncoding and missense variants to regulatory and binding readouts
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend variant interpretation from single-variant scores to chromatin, transcription factor, and RBP binding profiles.

ranked.headline: Simulation and inference frameworks recover mechanisms from dynamical biological data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply simulation, neural inference, and mechanochemical models to test mechanisms behind cortical, cellular, and Physarum dynamics.

ranked.headline: Pretrained biological encoders adapted with task-specific structure and biological priors
ranked.summary: Pretrained protein and DNA foundation models are being reused with added biological structure rather than retrained from scratch.

ranked.headline: Context-conditioned deep models predict drug response, toxicity and target activity
ranked.summary: Diffusion, multimodal fusion and biology-informed embeddings are now applied to drug design, cardiotoxicity and receptor activity prediction.

ranked.headline: Explicit Modeling of Noise and Observation Error in Biological Parameter Inference
ranked.summary: Recent studies treat missed events, uncertain sampling times, and noise as inputs to inference rather than as nuisance terms.

ranked.headline: Predictive tools for enzymes, protein stability and antibody-binding residues
ranked.summary: Sequence and structure predictors are being stress-tested on experimental and held-out data, exposing where generalisation and binding performance remain weak.

ranked.headline: Protein and genome language model embeddings predict bacterial gene function and abundance
ranked.summary: Learned sequence embeddings now target operon structure, community abundance, and biosynthetic gene cluster annotation directly from raw bacterial genomic data.

ranked.headline: Flow-based generative models infer latent dynamics from unpaired biological snapshots
ranked.summary: Unpaired longitudinal snapshots and multiview imaging now motivate flow-based models that encode geometry, lineage priors, and exact invertibility.

ranked.headline: Compact protein representations probe structure inference from sparse or degraded inputs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether learned protein and RNA representations recover interpretable structure from noisy, incomplete, or sparse inputs.

ranked.headline: LLM agents are benchmarked on biomedical reproducibility and process-level analysis tasks
ranked.summary: Full-capability agents reproduce 60.6% of computational biomedical papers, and agent evaluation is moving toward process-level trajectory scoring.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models tie biophysical drivers to microbial and tumour spatial outcomes
ranked.summary: Mechanistic models now test which physical or nutrient mechanisms produce observed colony separation, biofilm detachment, and tumour vessel remodelling.

ranked.headline: Graph learning on biological networks predicts protein, drug, and gene associations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply graph neural architectures with explicit biological priors to PPI, drug-target, and driver-gene prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Sampling and likelihood layers steer generative models of biomolecular conformations
ranked.summary: Generative and Bayesian sampling methods for biomolecular conformations are now being benchmarked against physics-based simulation and enhanced sampling.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale metabolic models predict bacterial and microbiome metabolic function
ranked.summary: Predictive metabolic models now couple enzyme annotation, community dynamics, and transport mapping to forecasts of bacterial and fungal metabolism.

ranked.headline: Pipeline choice shifts resistome profiles; control-free contamination detection emerges
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and workflows quantify how analysis tools alter metagenomic results, moving quality checks into routine analysis.

ranked.headline: Molecular dynamics resolves membrane and pH effects on residue and ligand energetics
ranked.summary: Recent unbiased, all-atom, and constant-pH simulations now quantify membrane- and pH-dependent energetics for residues and ligands.

ranked.headline: Interpretable deep models of neural activity recover known visual cortex selectivity
ranked.summary: Interpretability methods now test whether learned neural representations match known physiology across EEG, spiking, and fMRI-based encoding models.

ranked.headline: Adaptive parameters and architecture shape dynamics in neural and metabolic models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study treat adaptive time constants, enzyme levels, and firing-rate homeostasis as determinants of dynamics.

ranked.headline: Scoring method agreement and analytical choices as quantities in omics inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints quantify link confidence, demultiplexing concordance and preprocessing choices rather than assuming them.

ranked.headline: Isomir-resolved modeling of miRNA targeting and extracellular vesicle origin
ranked.summary: IsomiR-level reads are now being reassigned, targeted, and traced to cellular sources, extending analysis beyond parent miRNA abundance.

ranked.headline: Feedback, first-passage timing and output decoupling in stochastic biological dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published Markov model address feedback, first-passage timing and output decoupling in stochastic regulatory dynamics.

ranked.headline: Graph learners infer directed and local biomolecular networks from high-dimensional data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method extend network inference to interventional, multiomic, and snRNA-seq data with explicit error control.

ranked.headline: Packaging and dependency tooling for reproducible R and Python biology software
ranked.summary: Automated porting, scalable interactive workflows, and single-molecule analysis packages extend reproducibility beyond the software packaging layer.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools formalize reproducible steps from omics data to interpretation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published paper release automated tools for proteomics QC, glycan assignment, protein corona analysis, and variant visualization.

ranked.headline: Physics-based models link receptor mechanics and condensate material behaviour
ranked.summary: Physically grounded simulations are now addressing condensate material behaviour and T-cell antigen discrimination with open computational tools.

ranked.headline: Simulations and benchmarks map RNA conformational plasticity and protein-RNA recognition
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a benchmark extend RNA structure modeling to frameshifting elements, protein-RNA torsional preferences, and ligand docking.

ranked.headline: Discrete tokenization and generative models couple protein sequence and structure
ranked.summary: Discrete tokens for protein structure and conformational ensembles now feed joint sequence-structure generation and ligand-conditioned design models.

ranked.headline: Validity limits and constraints shape computational docking and peptide design workflows
ranked.summary: Recent preprints emphasize stated validity limits and multi-objective constraints over unconstrained score optimization in docking and design.

ranked.headline: Reusable pipelines annotate gene families, viral RNA structures and protein domains
ranked.summary: Three new preprints package annotation and visualization steps as reusable, open pipelines for gene family, viral ncRNA and protein domain analysis.
